title: Beyond Logits: Coherent Hallucination Mitigation via Attention Contrastive Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.34207v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate impressive multimodal capabilities, yet suffer from hallucination - generating factually inaccurate content. Contrastive Decoding (CD) mitigates this by contrasting amateur and expert branches at the logit level. However, our investigation reveals that such logit-level interventions fundamentally compromise generation coherence, necessitating restrictive penalty constraints unrelated to hallucination suppression.   We introduce Attention Contrastive Decoding (ACD), a training-free plug-in that complements logit-level CD by relocating part of the contrastive operations to the attention mechanism. Operating at an earlier stage of the forward pass, ACD performs smooth semantic-preserving interventions through an Adaptive Subtraction Strategy (ASS), which attenuates hallucination-associated attention patterns while amplifying critical visual information. translated_title: 超越Logits：基于注意力对比解码的连贯幻觉缓解方法
translated_abstract: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）展现出令人印象深刻的多模态能力，但饱受幻觉问题的困扰——即生成与事实不符的内容。对比解码通过在logit层面对比“业余”分支与“专家”分支来缓解这一问题。然而，我们的研究表明，此类logit层面的干预从根本上损害了生成的连贯性，因此需要引入与幻觉抑制无关的严格惩罚约束。我们提出了注意力对比解码（ACD），这是一种免训练的即插即用方法，通过将部分对比操作转移至注意力机制，对logit层面的CD形成补充。ACD在前向传播的较早阶段进行操作，通过自适应减法策略（ASS）实施平滑且保持语义的干预，在削弱与幻觉相关的注意力模式的同时，增强关键的视觉信息。大量实验表明……
tldr: 提出免训练的即插即用方法ACD，将对比操作从logit层面转移至注意力机制，通过削弱幻觉相关注意力模式并增强关键视觉信息，在缓解大型视觉语言模型幻觉的同时保持生成连贯性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Attention Contrastive Decoding (ACD), a training-free plug-in that shifts contrastive operations to the attention level, attenuating hallucination-associated attention patterns while amplifying critical visual information to mitigate hallucination in LVLMs without compromising generation coherence.
